## Passages
RESULT [weeds]: Real images only: box mAP 0.81. Cut-paste synthetic only: 0.64. Synthetic mixed with real: 0.83. About 40-50 plant instances were enough, automatic clipping matched manual clipping while cutting time from 170 to 5 minutes, and GAN-made instances did worse than real clipped ones.
US [weeds]: Cut-paste of real harvested weed crops is cheap and helps only when mixed with real images; alone it loses about 0.17 mAP. It suggests a small, controlled synthetic increment (tens of instances per species) rather than mass generation. Keeping the scene layout realistic (crop rows) mattered.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed box mAP: real 0.81, synthetic-only 0.64, mixed 0.83 (mask mAP 0.80/0.60/0.80). 40-50 instances were sufficient. Clipping 150 instances took about 170 min by hand vs about 5 min automatically, with comparable results. GAN instances underperformed.
